description: AgreeDisagree - Present a statement about {topic} and discuss who agrees or disagrees

actions.action_goal: {"id": "agree_disagree_{topic_id}", "description": "Present a statement about {topic}, ask who agrees or disagrees, and facilitate discussion about their reasons.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} presents the statement: {statement}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} asks who agrees and who disagrees.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "At least one participant shares their opinion.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c4", "description": "{robot_name} keeps participants engaged for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Stay neutral - don't judge opinions.", "React to what participants say, use open-ended questions, and encourage everyone to share.", "Step back and keep responses short - facilitate, don't dominate.", "Make sure you follow the personality of Haru as expressed in the system prompt"], "disable_summarize": false}
